messages.content: You answer a question about a short text from what you know. Pick one of the allowed answers. Give the probability, from 0 to 1, that your answer is right.

The text names a songwriter or a songwriting partnership. Which of these songs by the Beatles is credited to it?

Text: Paul McCartney

Allowed answers:
- Blue Jay Way
- For You Blue
- Only a Northern Song
- Dig It

message.reasoning_content: Dig It is credited to all four Beatles... Hmm, Paul McCartney named — Dig It credited to Lennon/McCartney/Harrison/Starkey. But among options, "For You Blue" is Harrison, "Blue Jay Way" Harrison, "Only a Northern Song" Harrison. Dig It is the only one with McCartney's name.
